python -c "
import ast
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(r'C:\Users\pho\repos\EmotivEpoc\ACTIVE_DEV\PhoLogToLabStreamingLayer\src\phologtolabstreaminglayer\logger_app.py')
src = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
tree = ast.parse(src)
# module-level
print('=== MODULE LEVEL ===')
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        print(f'func {node.name} L{node.lineno}')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
        print(f'class {node.name} L{node.lineno} bases={[ast.unparse(b) for b in node.bases]}')
        methods = []
        for item in node.body:
            if isinstance(item, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                decos = [ast.unparse(d) for d in item.decorator_list]
                methods.append((item.name, item.lineno, getattr(item, 'end_lineno', None), decos))
        for name, start, end, decos in methods:
            deco_s = f' @{decos}' if decos else ''
            print(f'  def {name} L{start}-{end}{deco_s}')
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
        targets = [ast.unparse(t) for t in node.targets]
        print(f'assign {targets} L{node.lineno}')
"
